# `<MapHero.Style />`
Style is a component that automatically adds sources / layers to the map from a style document.<br/>Only `sources` and `layers` are supported.<br/>Other fields such as `sprites`, `glyphs` etc. will be ignored. Not all layer / source attributes from the style spec are supported, in general the supported attributes are the ones listed on each layer and source page of these docs.<br/><br/>TODO: Maintainer forking this project does not understand the above comment regarding what is supported.

## Props
| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| ---- | :--: | :-----: | :------: | :----------: |
| json | `MapHeroStyleJSON \| URL` | `none` | `false` | A JSON object conforming to the MapHero style specification, or a URL to such JSON. |
